say:2:1041566601:1.text: It's a rare opportunity to see you here, my friend. I thought you were busy hosting another party.
say:2:1041566601:1.source_cn: 难得遇到你啊，朋友，我还以为你这会儿又在开宴会呢。

say:3:1041566602:1.text: Oh, hello there, my dear Baelran. Yes, well, I'm preparing. I'm still thinking about the theme of this new party.
say:3:1041566602:1.source_cn: 我在筹备，亲爱的巴赫朗，只是还需要点时间思考主题。

say:4:1041566603:1.text: I'm planning to host an exclusive dinner for a master jeweler who's unveiling some breathtaking new pieces.
say:4:1041566603:1.source_cn: 对了！最近有位珠宝大师刚刚准备了几样新作，我希望借机举...

say:5:1041566604:1.text: Half the magic of a party is the anticipation. I want to reveal just enough about the theme for people to prepare and let their imaginations run a little wild...
say:5:1041566604:1.source_cn: 所以在晚宴前，指定相应的主题，更能让我亲爱的宾客们做好准备。

say:6:1041566605:1.text: The last gathering I recall honored the Empire's new up-and-coming painter, and before that, we celebrated the invention of revolutionary musical instruments.
say:6:1041566605:1.source_cn: 上次应该是耀光新出现的先锋画师，再上次则是新乐器的发明...

say:7:1041566606:1.text: You never change, Dionel. You've always been passionate about the arts.
say:7:1041566606:1.source_cn: 亲爱的萨基塔里斯，你还是一如既往地这么热爱艺术。

say:8:1041566607:1.text: Ah, to have a life as colorful as yours...
say:8:1041566607:1.source_cn: 而你的生活也总是这样丰富多彩。

say:9:1041566608:1.text: You've always known me best, Baelran. Most people think I'm just a strumpet who likes to carouse.
say:9:1041566608:1.source_cn: 所以你才是我的朋友，亲爱的巴赫朗！很多人都认为我只是喜...

say:10:1041566609:1.text: Oh, don't get me wrong. I do love a good party. But toss in some breathtaking art? Suddenly, it's not just fun. It's magic.
say:10:1041566609:1.source_cn: 当然，我确实喜欢，但比起纯粹的饮酒作乐，我相信艺术的美...

say:11:1041566610:1.text: Your passion never wanes. I'm envious.
say:11:1041566610:1.source_cn: 你这充沛的情感也是一如既往地让我羡慕。

say:12:1041566611:1.text: And what you need is a shot of zest! You don't need to be so serious all the time.
say:12:1041566611:1.source_cn: 不不，我认为你就是太缺少真正的激情与欢乐了！别这么冷静...

say:13:1041566612:1.text: Don't skip out on this banquet this time. I was thinking you could bring some of your favorite pieces of jewelry with you.
say:13:1041566612:1.source_cn: 这次的宴会你不要缺席，我想好了，你就带着几样你喜欢的珠...

say:14:1041566613:1.text: Your collection always had such a distinctive charm. Once the artists and critics take notice, I imagine it'll rekindle a fire in you again.
say:14:1041566613:1.source_cn: 你的收藏品总是别有风味，或许在艺术家们的评点下，你也能...

say:15:1041566614:1.text: Alright, alright. Which ones do you want me to bring? Give me a list, and I promise I'll be there.
say:15:1041566614:1.source_cn: 好吧，好吧，你想要哪些？给我写个单子吧，我保证到场。
